title: Palworld Alpha Pals Guide | Where To Find Every Boss From Level 11 To 66 | Palworld Guide
description: Palworld 1.0 Alpha Pals guide: why to hunt them, the easiest level 11 Alphas, early, mid and high level bosses, Feybreak Alphas, Sealed Realms and legendary Pals. Names, regions and levels checked on the Palworld wiki and the Pindrop map in November 2026.

sections.heading: Alpha Pals explained
sections.script: Alpha Pals are the big boss versions of regular Pals in Palworld, and they are some of the best targets in the whole game. They are larger, they have more health, and they give far more experience when you beat them. They also drop better loot than their small cousins. In this video we walk through where to find Alpha Pals in Palworld one point zero, which ones are easy to start with, and which ones wait for you on Feybreak. We checked names, regions and levels against the Palworld wiki and the Pindrop map in November twenty twenty six. Alpha levels are rough, so trust your in game map first. We will not talk about breeding here. Think of this video as a map and a checklist. We go from the lowest level Alphas at the start of your adventure to the legendary bosses at the very end, so you can follow along with your own progress and pick your next target.

sections.heading: Why hunt Alphas
sections.script: Why bother with Alpha Pals? First, experience. An Alpha gives around ten times the experience of its normal version, so a single win can push your level up fast. Second, loot. Alphas drop higher tier items, and some of them can drop rare schematics. Third, you can catch them. Many Alphas can be captured, though their capture chance is usually lower than the normal Pal, so bring good Pal Spheres and weaken them first. Overworld Alphas also come back, so you can return to the same spot on a later day and farm them again. That makes them perfect for levelling and for loot runs. Alphas also give you something to aim for between story missions. When you feel stuck on levels, pick one Alpha from the right level range, prepare a team, and beat it. It is one of the fastest ways to move forward.

sections.heading: The easiest Alphas
sections.script: Let us start with the easy ones. The lowest level Alphas sit around level eleven. Alpha Gumoss and Alpha Sweepa both wait in the Sea Breeze Archipelago, and Alpha Chillet is near the Fortress Ruins. Alpha Dumud comes next at about level fourteen on the Isle of Murmurs. Alpha Penking is around level fifteen, and you reach it through a Sealed Realm called the Frozen Wings. These fights are a great first test. Bring Fire Pals for Gumoss, Sweepa and Chillet, because all three are weak to Fire, and use a Grass Pal against Dumud. Then try to catch one for your team. Do not forget to save your Pal Spheres for the capture. A caught Alpha shows a special icon next to its name, and it is a fun trophy to keep in your Palbox.

sections.heading: Early game Alphas
sections.script: Next are the early game Alphas between roughly level seventeen and twenty five. Alpha Grintale is around level seventeen on Marsh Island, and Alpha Nitewing is around level eighteen in the Deep Bamboo Thicket. Alpha Kingpaca waits near the Golden Hills at about level twenty three, and Alpha Fenglope is around level twenty five near the Foot of the Volcano. These Alphas hit harder, so do not rush in with a starter team. Bring healing food, a Pal that can take hits, and Pal Spheres that match their level. Winning here gives you strong experience for the climb towards the middle of the map. If an Alpha is too strong, do not be afraid to walk away, level up a little, and come back. Overworld Alphas return, so there is no rush, and a stronger team makes the fight much calmer.

sections.heading: Mid game Alphas
sections.script: The middle of the map has a lot of Alphas worth your time. Alpha Elphidran stands at the Ancient Ritual Site around level thirty. Alpha Mossanda Lux is on the Eastern Wild Island at about level thirty one. In the Bamboo Groves you can find Alpha Azurobe near level forty, and it is a Water and Dragon Pal that is weak to Electric and Ice. Alpha Elphidran is a Dragon, so Ice helps there too. These fights are longer, and the Alphas have a lot of health, so bring a team with the right element and plenty of food. Rewards here are worth the effort. A good habit is to check the Alpha weakness before you leave base. Swapping one Pal in your party for the right element can cut a long fight in half and save a lot of healing food.

sections.heading: High level Alphas
sections.script: Now the heavy hitters. Alpha Anubis guards the Twilight Dunes at around level fifty five, and it is a Ground Pal that is weak to Grass. Alpha Jormuntide is in the Scars of War near level fifty five, and Alpha Blazamut stands in the Ruined Fortress City on Mount Obsidian near level fifty two. Blazamut is a Fire Pal, so Water works well against it. These are real boss fights. Come with a high level team, strong armor, and a plan for dodging. If you can capture one of these, you get a very strong Pal for your party or your base. Remember to bring some spare Pal Spheres, healing items and a mount so you can run away if the fight turns bad. A careful retreat is better than losing your whole party.

sections.heading: Feybreak Alphas
sections.script: Feybreak is the place for Alpha hunters. The Pindrop map shows more Alphas on Feybreak than in any other single region. The levels are high, mostly around sixty to sixty six. Alpha Smokie waits on the Loess Plains, Alpha Gildane is around level sixty three, Alpha Warsect Terra is near level sixty four, and Alpha Cryolinx Terra is near level sixty two on the Deserted Ash Plateau. Alpha Prunelia and Alpha Nitemary also live here. Prepare before you arrive. Bring your best Pals, plenty of healing items, and the right elements, because Feybreak Alphas are some of the toughest fights in the game. Many of these Alphas are Terra or Noct variants, which look and fight a little differently from the Pals you know, so read their element before you attack and plan your team around it.

sections.heading: Sealed Realms and legends
sections.script: Some Alphas live inside Sealed Realms. These are special boss arenas that you enter from a marked spot on the map. Alpha Penking, Alpha Vaelet and Alpha Verdash all have Sealed Realm fights, and Alpha Smokie and Alpha Prunelia do as well. Legendary Pals such as Paladius, Necromus, Frostallion and Jetragon also appear on the overworld as Alphas, usually at levels sixty and above. Jetragon is the top of the list at about level seventy. Treat these as endgame goals. Go in with full health, strong elements, and a team that can survive a long fight.

sections.heading: How to win and capture
sections.script: Here is a simple plan for any Alpha. One, check its element and use the matching weakness. Two, bring a Pal that is at or above the Alpha level, and keep your own armor up to date. Three, do not chase the Alpha too far from its home spot, because bosses can retreat to their starting area. Four, if you want to catch it, lower its health first and use strong Pal Spheres, since Alphas are harder to catch than normal Pals. Five, keep healing food ready. Follow those steps and even the hardest Alpha becomes a good farm for experience and loot.

sections.heading: Which Alpha is next
sections.script: That is our Alpha Pal guide for Palworld one point zero, from level eleven Gumoss all the way to the legendary bosses and the Feybreak monsters. We checked every name, region and level on the Palworld wiki and the Pindrop map in November twenty twenty six, but Alpha levels can change after updates, so always trust the in game map. Which Alpha Pal have you already caught, and which one are you going to hunt next? Tell us in the comments below.
